meta.method: Post-stratification: skill composition is reweighted so ISCO-08 occupation strata match official employment shares. Strata are ISCO 2-digit, collapsed to 1-digit where the ad cell has < 50 ads or the reference lacks 2-digit detail. Korea uses a KSCO-harmonised 1-digit scheme; Malaysia uses 1-digit.

strata.classification: KSCO 7th rev. (national); ISCO 2+3 merged, ISCO 5 = service+sales
